      "evidence": "Modifies bitcoinkernel C API headers and implementation in src/kernel/ to introduce structured logging and remove node logging dependencies.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Directly redesigns the bitcoinkernel public logging interface to deliver structured `btck_LogEntry` objects instead of requiring callers to parse formatted strings. As described in the problem statement, this replaces a 'cumbersome, brittle, and inefficient' interface, removes node-oriented logging mechanisms from the library build, and unblocks tracking issues #34062 and #27587."
    },

      "name": "tests",

      "rationale": "Does not alter general test runners, harness machinery, or frameworks; changes in src/test/kernel and valgrind.supp strictly follow the kernel logging refactoring."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp are mechanical updates to adapt to the modified bitcoinkernel API.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Only touches src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp (+5/-12) to update its call sites to the new kernel logging interface."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The utils definition explicitly excludes the kernel API ('Not utils: ... the kernel API (kernel)').",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Excluded by definition because the subject is the libbitcoinkernel logging API and its internal library logger adapter rather than common node logging utilities."
    },
